item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description:
What's New

  • fix(windows): regenerate C# bindings and revert CI bindgen step
  • fix(windows): add missing using directive and generate bindings in CI
  • Update appcast.xml for v1.2.0
  • chore: bump version to 1.2.0
  • chore: bump rand to 0.9 and thiserror to 2
  • fix(sync): re-sync listener to host track on mismatch
  • feat: add shared queue sync across room participants
  • fix(website): use www subdomain for canonical URLs
  • fix(website): comprehensive SEO improvements
  • feat(website): add Windows download button to landing page
  • feat(windows): add in-app auto-update with package manager detection
  • feat(signing): switch to Azure Trusted Signing for Windows MSIX
  • refactor(website): simplify landing page design and add smooth scrolling
  • fix(session): improve room state management and timeout handling Prevents "already in room" issues when joining state or after getting timed out
  • feat: add landing page website
  • fix(session): trim whitespace from API token input
  • docs: update diagram backgrounds from transparent to white
  • docs: pre-render diagrams as SVGs
  • Update appcast.xml for v1.1.0
